narr: Deep tropical moisture from the remnants of Hurricane Nicholas overspread the area and led to the development of bands of very heavy rainfall. The slow motion of these bands produced copious amounts of rain which led to flash flooding across portions of northwest Florida.
ev: Flooding was reported in the Shangri-La neighborhood off of Highway 98. Several streets were flooded in downtown Pensacola. Social media pictures showed water up to the top of tires in a parking lot in West Pensacola.
Ortega St and Onich Dr in Navarre was closed to due to flooding. Other roads in Navarre were flooded as well, including Avenida De Sol north of Torres St and along High School Blvd.
